// typecheck: Spelled out rather than the '{}' the packages use: the shared definition in nx.json compiles tsconfig.lib.json, which a Playwright suite has no reason to have. The project's single tsconfig.json covers every spec, page object and fixture, and is the only thing that type-checks them — Playwright transpiles each file at run time without checking it.
